# HR Automotive

> Family-run car body repair, bodywork and paint specialist in Halifax, West Yorkshire. We also sell quality used cars, repaired and prepared in-house.

Tagline: Family Run. Professionally Done.
Location: Halifax, West Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Email: HRautomotivefamily@gmail.com

## About
HR Automotive is a family-owned bodyshop in Halifax offering professional
accident and collision repair, bodywork, dent and scratch removal, panel
replacement, paintwork and resprays, insurance repairs, alloy wheel repairs and
full vehicle restoration — professional results without dealership prices. We
also sell affordable used cars that we repair and prepare ourselves.

## Areas served
Halifax, Calderdale, Brighouse, Elland, Sowerby Bridge, Hebden Bridge,
Huddersfield, Bradford and the wider West Yorkshire.

## Services
- Accident & collision repairs
- Bodywork and panel repair / replacement
- Dent removal and scratch repairs
- Paintwork, resprays and colour matching
- Insurance repairs (handled directly)
- Alloy wheel repairs
- Vehicle restoration
- Used car sales

## Opening hours
Monday–Friday: 8:00–18:00
Saturday: 9:00–14:00
Sunday: Closed

## Contact
Email HRautomotivefamily@gmail.com for a free, no-obligation quote or to book in.
